meta.title: Services
meta.description: Six stages from requirement to operation: buyer qualification, needs assessment, manufacturer matching, deal structuring, logistics and customs, and after-sales support.

hero.title: Six stages from requirement to operation.
hero.text: Every deal follows the same path. Each stage has an owner on our side, so neither the buyer nor the manufacturer is left chasing the next step.

stages.name: Buyer identification and qualification
stages.body: We find East African manufacturers with real equipment needs and check their capacity, budget and timelines before anyone invests time in a quote.
you: A qualified lead, not a cold contact
A clear picture of the opportunity

stages.name: Needs assessment
stages.alt: Engineer reviewing a tablet on a factory floor
stages.body: A technical review of specifications, production volumes and operating constraints, turned into a brief a manufacturer can quote against.
you: A specification both sides agree on

stages.name: Manufacturer matching
stages.body: We pair the buyer with a suitable Italian manufacturer from our verified network.
we: Check fit on capability and capacity
you: A maker vetted for export readiness
A direct relationship, no agent chain

stages.name: Negotiation and deal structuring
stages.alt: Conveyor lines in a production hall
stages.body: Price, terms, payment and contract conditions are handled for both sides so the deal holds up.
you: A deal that works for both parties

stages.name: Logistics and customs coordination
stages.alt: Container ship berthing at a port
stages.body: Freight, documentation and clearance from the Italian factory to the buyer's site.

stages.name: After-sales support
stages.body: A single local contact for installation, spare parts, technical questions and service.
we: Route technical questions to the maker
you: Support that continues past the invoice

items.q: Can you handle only part of the process?
items.a: Our model is end to end, because that is where accountability matters most. Tell us where you are in a deal and we will tell you honestly how we can help.
On technical capability, capacity, quality and export readiness, before a buyer sees a quote.
We coordinate freight, documentation and clearance from the Italian factory to the buyer's site.
We serve six East African markets from our Nairobi office. Get in touch to confirm coverage for your destination.

cta.title: Ready to start at stage one?
cta.text: Share your requirement or your product range. We'll map the path for your deal.
